quote.text: We built ivybek academy because we remember the confusion - the contradictory advice, the generic templates, the anxiety of not knowing if your application truly reflected you. We've guided hundreds through admissions. Now we're bringing that experience, alongside a big team with wealth of expertise in top-tier admissions, directly to students who deserve better than guesswork.

testimonials.title: Testimonials from our graduates
testimonials.description: Before enrolling students in our beginner courses, we assess their English language, mathematics, and problem-solving skills.

reviews.name: Sevara
reviews.feedback: I joined the Essay Program, unsure if it could improve my writing. But through intense handwriting reflections and even a stand-up comedy challenge, the classes became the most transformative I’ve ever taken. I was taught that ‘writers catch the moments most people miss,’ pushing me to notice more, think deeper, and write in a new dimension. Now writing - once a struggle - has become my passion and a key part of my future studies

reviews.name: Ozodbek
reviews.feedback: After a painful wave of rejections, I joined Ivybek during my gap year. We explored Chekhov, Nabokov, and Kafka, producing 10,000 words of deep reflections. Each session taught me to turn small moments into meaningful ideas. That transformation rebuilt my application and led to my acceptance to Amherst College with a $403,000 full-ride scholarship—a dream I thought was gone.

reviews.name: Murod
reviews.feedback: High scores and activities aren’t enough— how you present them matters. Ivybek became the foundation of my admissions journey. We wrote thousands of words of reflections, read widely, and refined every draft. Through our weekly meetings, we shaped my NYU Abu Dhabi application into a narrative admissions officers couldn’t ignore.

reviews.name: Jahongir
reviews.feedback: I was academically strong but too focused on tests, becoming ‘standard’ myself. Levsha’s reminder—‘You are smart. You just have to show it!’—shifted everything. Over two months, inspired by thinkers like Plato and Chekhov, I wrote 100 pages of reflections that reshaped me from an A-level test-taker into a genuinely open-minded student. That growth led to acceptances to CMU-Q and GU-Q with a story that finally felt real.

reviews.name: Saidamirxon
reviews.feedback: I had no idea my life was about to be divided into before and after. With Ivybek, I discovered far more than a roadmap to a top college. My mentors instilled in me the conviction that 'impossible' simply doesn't exist. Frankly, I arrived with virtually no extracurriculars, yet within months of our collective effort, my trajectory transformed entirely. I aced APs, secured a position at a presidential think-tank, became a research assistant to arguably Uzbekistan's foremost economist, and achieved a Guinness World Record

reviews.name: Asila
reviews.feedback: A year ago, I was a high schooler with dreams of studying abroad, overwhelmed by questions: How could I build meaningful extracurriculars? Would my application stand out? Ivybek changed everything. I secured a full-ride to TKS, got an internship at Silk Road Institute, did research with a Harvard postdoc, became a research assistant to tenured Yale professor, and more. Forty thousand words of reflection later, I finally saw myself clearly. Got extensive feedback on everything (essays, narratives, strategy). Ivybek fundamentally shifted how I understood top-tier admissions. They changed my life course. Moreover, Ivybek helped me crack the code on my whole story: connected dots I didn't know existed, availed in building narratives that actually work, edited essays that hit different. The strategies were next level. Everything finally clicked into place.

items.question: What is IvyBek?
items.answer: IvyBek is a comprehensive mentorship platform designed to guide ambitious students through the college admissions process, helping them build strong profiles and achieve their educational goals.

items.question: How does the mentorship program work?
items.answer: Our mentorship program pairs students with experienced mentors who provide personalized guidance on building a strong profile, crafting compelling essays, and navigating the admissions process.

items.question: What kind of resources do you offer for free?
items.answer: We offer a variety of free resources, including guides on university applications, YouTube podcast links, and other tools to help students prepare for college admissions.

items.question: How can I contact your support team?
items.answer: You can contact our support team by filling out the contact form on our website or by reaching out to us directly through the provided contact information.
